blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Healthy Home survived a late-game thriller against Titan, 67-66, while Virtouso and Konstrukt scored contrasting victories as the Cebu Architects Basketball Club (CABC) 4th Boysen Cup resumed on Sunday, November 8, at the Benedicto College-Cebu City Gymnasium. The CABC Boysen Cup is the only basketball tournament in Cebu featuring professional and licensed architects, providing members of the architectural profession with an opportunity to showcase their skills on the basketball court. Healthy Home overcame 10 lead changes and seven deadlocks before escaping with the narrow victory, highlighting the tournament’s return following a brief holiday break. READ: CABC 4th […]...
